caption: The drawing depicts two views of a toy soldier figure, one from the front (on the left) and one from the back (on the right), arranged on a plain, neutral background. The figure has an elaborate red plume on top of a tall black hat with red stripes. The face is light brown, with black hair, mustache, and eyebrows, while facial features are outlined in black. The soldier wears a green jacket with long sleeves, gold-trimmed cuffs, and gold vertical buttons. A red sash is tied around the neck. The pants are bright red, with decorative gold and grey elements at the waist, and the lower legs, below the knee, are green, matching the jacket. Black boots with gold stripes at the top complete the footwear. The hands of the figure are beige or tan. The back view shows the same costume details but without the facial features. The entire composition is rendered in colored drawing tools, with careful attention to the stripes, buttons, and feathers.
title: Knitted Doll "Duke"
